new: In AR the room scan no longer hides things by default: Real world hides now says yes (what the headset sees: people, hands, furniture), then yes, with the room scan, room scan only and nothing.
Smooth edges, a new switch beside it on the menu's Settings tab (AR only, off by default): softer edges round real things, at a small cost.
A studio scene set to Always now uses the headset's depth alone, without the room scan.
test: In AR on a headset that has a room scan, without touching the setting: Real world hides should say yes, and the walls of the scan should no longer cut into a story.
Press Real world hides through all four values and back to yes: each should hide what its name says.
Hold a hand before a story with Smooth edges off, then on: the edge round the hand should go from steps to smooth.
Record a run (Debug tab) with Smooth edges on and another with it off, and compare the frame times.
untested: How the smooth edges look and what they cost on a real headset (at 120 Hz too): only a pretend headset's depth was checked.
The new default with a real room scan, and the phone's depth with Smooth edges on.
